verdict.rationale: Tailscale documents headless/CI-friendly automation via GitHub Actions integration for runners (tailscale-docs-15), Docker container usage (tailscale-docs-11), Kubernetes sidecar with auth/routing (tailscale-docs-17), tsnet Go package for embedding in programs (tailscale-docs-14), and general IaC/webhook automation (tailscale-docs-12). A documented CLI exists (tailscale-probe-3), supporting scripted/non-interactive use. However, community evidence raises concerns about auth key/API key expiry requiring periodic re-login (tailscale-comm-15), which complicates pure headless automation, and there's no first-party evidence of a dedicated 'headless mode' flag or extensive CI-specific docs beyond the GitHub Actions mention. missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of long-running headless CI setups, explicit auth-key rotation/ephemeral node lifecycle docs for CI, and confirmation the API key expiry issue (raised in community) doesn't undermine automation reliability.
